name: kwapso
description: kwapso — the agency app + the client portal by Swift Struck. web/ = the agency screens, web-portal/ = the client screens, workers/ = the brains (two gateways over one shared set), shared/ = types all sides agree on.

scripts.build: npm run build:static --workspace=kwapso-web && npm run build:portal
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=kwapso-auth && npm run test --workspace=kwapso-tenancy && npm run test --workspace=kwapso-content && npm run test --workspace=kwapso-data-ops && npm run test --workspace=kwapso-mcp && npm run test --workspace=kwapso-realtime && npm run test --workspace=kwapso-gateway && npm run test --workspace=kwapso-portal-gateway && npm run test --workspace=kwapso-web && npm run test --workspace=kwapso-portal-web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit -p web && npx tsc --noEmit -p web-portal && npx tsc --noEmit -p workers/auth && npx tsc --noEmit -p workers/tenancy && npx tsc --noEmit -p workers/content && npx tsc --noEmit -p workers/data-ops && npx tsc --noEmit -p workers/realtime && npx tsc --noEmit -p workers/gateway && npx tsc --noEmit -p workers/portal-gateway && npx tsc --noEmit -p workers/mcp && npm test
scripts.check:built: npm run build && REQUIRE_EXPORT=1 npm run test --workspace=kwapso-web && REQUIRE_EXPORT=1 npm run test --workspace=kwapso-portal-web
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run account:check && npm run lang:check && npm run check:built && npm run deploy:staging --workspace=kwapso-realtime && npm run deploy:staging --workspace=kwapso-auth && npm run deploy:staging --workspace=kwapso-tenancy && npm run migrations:check -- staging && npm run deploy:staging --workspace=kwapso-content && npm run deploy:staging --workspace=kwapso-data-ops && npm run deploy:staging --workspace=kwapso-mcp && npm run deploy:staging --workspace=kwapso-gateway && npm run deploy:staging --workspace=kwapso-portal-gateway && npm run smoke:staging && npm run smoke:portal
scripts.deploy:production: npm run account:check && npm run lang:check && npm run check:built && npm run deploy:production --workspace=kwapso-realtime && npm run deploy:production --workspace=kwapso-auth && npm run deploy:production --workspace=kwapso-tenancy && npm run migrations:check -- production && npm run deploy:production --workspace=kwapso-content && npm run deploy:production --workspace=kwapso-data-ops && npm run deploy:production --workspace=kwapso-mcp && npm run deploy:production --workspace=kwapso-gateway && npm run deploy:production --workspace=kwapso-portal-gateway
